cases.note: FCFS breaks a tie in arrival by the order the processes were added, not by name
SJF ties: equal bursts go by earlier arrival, then by the order added
SJF never preempts and only chooses among processes that have arrived
a process added after a run is not in its results until the next run
times count from each process's arrival; the CPU idles until the next arrival
averages are fractions in lowest terms: 0/1 and whole numbers over 1
a process arriving at the very tick the CPU frees up is a candidate
a quantum longer than every burst behaves like first come, first served
processes arriving at the tick a quantum ends queue ahead of the preempted process
a process that finishes as its quantum ends leaves; it does not go back to the queue
a new arrival joins the back of the queue, not the front
one process continuing after its quantum is one segment and no switch; idle time between two processes is still a switch
response time counts from arrival to the first tick on the CPU
a process preempted by a higher queue keeps the part of its allotment it has used
a preempted process goes to the back of its own queue
a boost lifts the running process too and gives it a fresh allotment; queues join top first
with one queue the feedback queue is round robin
an arrival preempts a process of a lower queue at once; the bottom queue runs round robin
boosts fall on multiples of the period, also on a tick where a process is demoted
the boost clock keeps running while the CPU is idle
one core is round robin, and stealing needs a second core
utilization is busy ticks over the run from time 0 to the last finish; out-of-range cores give an empty string
the load of a core counts its running process, its queue and a process whose quantum just ended
an idle core steals from the core with the longest queue, lowest index on a tie, taking its last process
stealing takes the process at the back of the victim's queue
utilization is a fraction in lowest terms; an unused core is 0/1
the thief compares every core's queue and takes the back of the longest
